name: Kuramoto Sync
desc: A lattice of coupled Kuramoto phase-oscillators that spontaneously synchronizes out of random noise into flowing rainbow phase-domains, rotating spirals and sweeping traveling waves — a shimmering map of collective synchronization, rendered as full-hue phase-wheel, cool ocean, warm ember, hard two-ink duotone, or bioluminescent iso-phase veins.

scale.doc: display zoom — magnify a swept sub-region of the field

speed.doc: integration steps/frame — wave rotation & sync rate

coupling.doc: K — coupling strength; low = incoherent shimmer, high = big smooth synced domains

spread.doc: natural-frequency heterogeneity — order (clean spirals) <-> turbulent churn

density.doc: wandering pacemaker count — how many fresh rotors keep nucleating

cores.doc: seeded spiral singularity count (re-tiles the phase field on change)

hue.doc: base hue offset rotating the phase->color wheel

style.doc: phase-wheel = full-hue sync bands / ocean = cool blue-teal / ember = warm thermal / duotone = hard two-ink riso posterization / bioluminescent = bright iso-phase wavefront veins on dark

seed.doc: deterministic spiral layout, handedness & natural-freq field

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
